purpose: Exact implementation/runtime identity for SAP monetary qualification receipts

runtime.note: Do not infer conductor/runtime version from HDK/HDI pins.

countersigning.qualification_rule: Any qualification claim depending on countersigning must record the exact runtime feature configuration.

capability_mode.qualification_rule: Record every capability grant required by the exercised qualification path.

qualification_binding.rule: A reserve qualification receipt is invalid when any required implementation identity is absent or differs from the executed environment.
